$comment: Structured artifact shapes consumed/produced by roles. These are documentation of the stable handoff contract; production code validates the generic modeled-resource envelope, not domain-specific shapes.

fields.description: Confirmed business brief fields (domain_name, business_goal, scope, ...).

coverage.description: Coverage partitions the business scope into Work Units with exact dependencies and CQ traces.

candidate.description: Merged Work Unit results for one ontology, bound by hash to its review.

summary.description: Stage Summary; built only from that stage's bounded visible events and stable artifact references.

verification.description: Observed CQ/retrieval/provenance evidence for the applied model; verdict PASS only on observed results.
